info.name: Well-Being Platform API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Well-Being Web Platform. 

**Setup:**
1. Set the `baseUrl` variable to your server (default: http://localhost:5000)
2. Run **Register** or **Login** first — the token auto-saves to `authToken`
3. All protected routes automatically use the saved token via collection-level auth
4. **Blog:** Optional multipart field **authorId** (`users.id`); omit on create to default author to the authenticated admin. Optional **author** / **authorDisplayName** for public byline text. Responses include **authorDisplayName**, **author** `{ id, firstName, lastName } | null`, and **authorId**. **Login** / **Register** save **userId** when `data.user.id` is present. **Create** / **Create (Draft)** test scripts save `blogPostId` and `blogSlug`. Admin update/delete and **Get by ID (admin)** use `blogPostId`. Public **Get by Slug** uses `blogSlug`.
5. **Team (Our Team page):** Public `GET /api/team` — published members (`name`, `role`, `photoUrl`, `order`). Admin CRUD on `/api/team` with multipart field **photo** (or **photoUrl**). Saves `teamMemberId` on create. Admin list: `GET /api/team/admin/all?page=&limit=`. Optional photo: add form-data key `photo` (File) when uploading — pick a file, not a folder.
6. **Admin list GETs** (users, programs, blog, payments, consultations, testimonials admin, camp participants, Cal event types): use `?page=1&limit=20` (limit max 100). **Get All Users** accepts optional `?search=` (first name, last name, email). **Get All Consultations** accepts optional `?search=` (user name/email, service title) and optional `?status=` (`PENDING`, `PENDING_PAYMENT`, `CONFIRMED`, `CANCELLED`, `COMPLETED`). **Get All Programs** — public `GET /api/programs` and admin `GET /api/programs/admin/all` — accepts optional `?search=` (title, description) and optional `?category=` (`LEADERS`, `STUDENTS`, `PROFESSIONALS`). Public list is unpaginated `{ data }`; admin list is paginated `{ data, meta }`. **Newsletter:** `POST /api/newsletter/subscribe` (JSON: `email`, optional `source`) stores locally and syncs to Resend Contacts when `RESEND_API_KEY` is set; optional comma-separated `RESEND_NEWSLETTER_SEGMENT_IDS`. `GET /api/newsletter/unsubscribe?token=` — browser redirect to `CLIENT_URL` query flags; `?format=json` or `Accept: application/json` returns JSON. **Admin:** `GET /api/admin/newsletter/subscriptions` — paginated (`page`, `limit`), optional `search` (email/source), optional `status` (`all`|`active`|`unsubscribed`); excludes `unsubscribeToken` from rows. **Programmes (learner progress):** `GET /api/dashboard` includes `progress` on each purchased programme (`payment` SUCCESS). `GET /api/dashboard/programs/:id` merges `completedAt` on modules plus `progress`. `POST /api/dashboard/programs/:programId/modules/:moduleId/complete` records module completion when the learner finishes — idempotent.
7. **Chat:** `GET /api/chat/config` returns intro, disclaimers, and suggested prompts for the widget. Run **Create Chat Session** first — saves `chatSessionId` and sets httpOnly session cookies (enable Postman cookie jar). Then **Send Chat Message** (`stream: false` for JSON; set `stream: true` with `Accept: text/event-stream` for SSE when enabled). Admin: run **Reindex Chat Knowledge** after deploy (`npm run chat:reindex`) so RAG has indexed content.

**Seeded Admin:**
- Email: admin@wellbeing.com
- Password: Admin@1234

Returns the authenticated user: core fields plus Settings — phone, timezone, notifyEmail, notifyProgramReminders, notifyPush, hasPassword — and createdAt.
OAuth-only accounts typically have hasPassword false.

Partial update (send at least one field). Allowed: firstName, lastName, email, phone (string or null to clear), timezone (IANA e.g. Africa/Lagos, or null/"" to clear). Changing email sets isEmailVerified false and triggers a verification email; server sets a refreshed auth cookie (browser clients).
Requires an existing hashed password on the account. Google-only accounts (no password): use Forgot password flow or omit this call. Incorrect currentPassword returns 401.
Partial PATCH: include at least one of notifyEmail, notifyProgramReminders, notifyPush (booleans). Defaults on new users match the product: email=true, reminders=false, push=true.

Confirm email using the token from the verification email (48h expiry). Set `verifyToken` from the email link query string. Response `data`: id, firstName, lastName, email, role, isEmailVerified, createdAt — use GET /me for Settings fields.
Logged-in users only. Sends a new verification link if the account is not yet verified.
Sends a password reset link to the provided email. Always returns 200 to prevent email enumeration.
Reset the password using the token from the reset email. Token expires in 15 minutes.

Returns full camp details including tiers, images, published testimonials, benefits, seatsTaken, and seatsRemaining.

Submits or refreshes a camp application. tierId required. Success 201: data includes status=PENDING_PAYMENT, paymentExpiresAt (~60 min ISO), tier, camp. Message: Application submitted. Please complete payment within 60 minutes. Then POST /api/payments/initialize with type CAMP and itemId = registration id.

Retry errors: You have already applied for this camp. (CONFIRMED); You have a pending application for this camp... (active hold — resume Paystack); A previous payment is pending review... (SUCCESS payment awaiting ops refund). After worker marks EXPIRED, POST register again reuses the same row with a fresh paymentExpiresAt.
Returns the logged-in user's registration for this camp (status, paymentExpiresAt, tier, payment) or data=null when none. Use to drive Apply vs Complete payment vs Confirmed without guessing.

Initializes a payment for a program purchase. Returns an authorizationUrl — redirect the user to this URL to complete payment.

Optional body fields:
- provider — 'PAYSTACK' (default) or 'FLUTTERWAVE'.
- currency — ISO code (NGN, USD, GBP, ...). Defaults to PAYMENT_DEFAULT_CURRENCY (NGN).

Response includes provider, currency, authorizationUrl, and reference.
Flutterwave variant of the program init call — use when Paystack rejects an international card. Server must have FLUTTERWAVE_SECRET_KEY and FLUTTERWAVE_WEBHOOK_HASH set.

Initializes a payment for CAMP. itemId = camp registration id. Only allowed while registration is payable (PENDING_PAYMENT with future paymentExpiresAt).

Optional: provider (PAYSTACK | FLUTTERWAVE), currency (ISO).

400: You have already paid for this application. OR This application has expired. Please re-apply to obtain a new payment window.

Returns purchases (successful programme purchases include progress rollup), camp registrations (status, paymentExpiresAt, payment.status/amount/createdAt for countdown CTAs), and consultations.

Call when the learner finishes a module (e.g. video ended, quiz submitted). Idempotent. Returns updated `ProgramProgressOverview`. Sets `purchase.programCompletedAt` when 100% modules done.

Emails **admin Settings → supportEmail**. JSON: `message` (required, 10–4000 chars), `subject` optional (max 200). Sets **Reply-To** to the learner email. Respects **emailNotificationsEnabled** (mailer may no-op). Requires same auth + email verification rules as other dashboard writes.

Emails the program’s **facilitatorEmail** (set in admin program form). Requires an active **purchase** with successful payment. Same body rules as Contact support. Returns **400** if facilitator email is missing — UI can fall back to Contact support.
Public widget bootstrap — intro, disclaimers, suggested prompts, and streaming flag.

Send a user message (JSON response). Requires session cookies from Create Chat Session. Run `npm run chat:reindex` after deploy so RAG has indexed content.
